limitations: Baseline recipe/initial-state defaults are not proven mode-switch defaults.
Preset assignment associates a state key with a mode declaratively but does not prove control visibility or rendered effect.
Only five shader mode registries establish labels and numeric bounds. The exported DITHER_ALGOS list additionally establishes ditherAlgo option IDs. Other unknown descriptor fields remain null.
Unknown string enum alternatives are not inferred from renderer branches or sample presets.
UI controls and additional pro renderers are lazy-loaded; captured initial scripts are an incomplete module set.
No runtime probe, frame rendering, source script execution, export round trip or visual verification performed.
Array/object-valued state fields may be structured data, not single UI controls.
NULL modeSwitchDefaults or completeControlSchema means unknown, not absent.
